caption: A steaming bowl of tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with tender pork slices and vibrant green scallions. Served in a white ceramic bowl with black Greek-key trim, it rests on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

segments_info.text: Light brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and smooth surface texture.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy beige, glossy, with visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
White ceramic ramen bowl with black Greek key pattern and Japanese text along its rim.
